notes.title: v1.0.4.3 - January 2, 2021
notes.content:
People asked for 120 FPS, so this adds an option to set 120 FPS. I also added an option to turn VSync on or off, plus an option for sleeping between frames. Some people reported they weren't getting 60 FPS, so this might have been the cause. The app spends more time waiting for the next frame then it does rendering it, so making the app sleep prevents needless CPU usage while it waits. Perhaps it liked to "sleep in" sometimes. ːsteammockingː

Fixed how the waste pile spreads out in Duchess of Luynes after undo or redo.
Fixed the limited redeal in Little Windmill so that you can actually play the flipped card.

PS: You can press control-P to toggle seeing the current FPS you are getting in the top-left corner.

notes.title: v1.0.4 - September 5, 2020
notes.content:
Version 1.0.4 - What's new:
- TriPeaks: If you clear the layout, you no longer have to flip the remaining cards.
   This also means that it is now possible to win a game in under 51 moves.
- German Patience: The scoring has been fixed.
   It now scores the built sequences rather than the number of cards in the waste pile.
- New York: You can no longer play cards from the foundations to the 3 waste piles.
   This didn't hurt anything, but it shouldn't be allowed.
- The audio no longer uses Windows Media Player.
   This might affect a few users who could not launch the game if they didn't have WMP.
